bagPolicy.summary: Only small bags, defined as A4 size or smaller, are allowed into the venue. Large bags such as backpacks and suitcases are not permitted.
bagPolicy.note: No bags are permitted in the Rear Circle Standing section for events. There is a cloakroom on site for small bags.

parking.note: Eventim Apollo does not have any parking spaces and advises against driving and parking in the surrounding residential areas due to high theft rates. For Blue Badge holders' parking information, visit the LB Hammersmith & Fulham website.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Eventim Apollo's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The Eventim Apollo offers a variety of food and drink options for visitors. While specific vendors are not listed, guests can expect a selection of snacks and beverages available throughout the venue. Special offerings or highlights are not detailed.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Eventim Apollo, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Eventim Apollo's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Eventim Apollo. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Eventim Apollo. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
